name: ONLYOFFICE Docs
summary: HTTP 80 with the editing WebSocket kept open.
notes: The document server works out its own address from X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host, which this node sends. /healthcheck answers 200 with true or false in the body, so the check proves the server is answering rather than that its database and queue are well. Editing runs over a WebSocket for as long as a document is open.
